There is no public “.bin” firmware that could be safely modified. Brother distributes firmware only through its server as an encrypted, signed .djf file – the printer rejects modified files, and if it accepted one it could be bricked for good.
So Wi‑Fi reliability is improved differently: with the latest official firmware (Brother fixes Wi‑Fi bugs and security holes in it) and the right router settings – see Reliability.

PrintBridge creates a reliable macOS print queue. Unlike the usual one it remembers the printer’s stable address instead of looking it up via Bonjour every time, and it retries jobs while the printer sleeps instead of dropping them. File › Print then works in every app.
